name: TREEGONE
description: TREEGONE: a 6- or 12-voice poly in the style of the Sequential Trigon-6. Three oscillators with sync, osc 3 LO, noise, feedback and drive, three filters (LP1 4-pole OTA, LP2 4/2-pole ladder, 2-pole OTA state variable), two ADSR, LFO, poly mod, aftertouch, distortion, two effects, glide, unison with chord memory, arp and poly sequencer. The same engine as the TREEGONE VST3.
author: swtdr34mz
